relations: Right hand gripping the polka-dot mug handle -> mug rotates about its axis while staying beside the pot.
Hand rotation tips the rim backward -> empty white interior becomes visible, then eases toward upright.
Saucepan resting on the burner with frothy brown liquid -> pot and liquid level remain still, no pouring occurs.
Handheld camera shake -> white tiles and stove grates shift a few pixels without moving the mug's location.
caption: The video captures a handheld kitchen scene where a black saucepan rests on a gas burner, holding a light-brown frothy liquid against a white tiled backsplash. A right hand grips the handle of a white ceramic mug patterned with black polka dots and a pink band near its base. The mug stays beside the pot without crossing over it or moving to another location. Its orientation changes as the hand rotates it. The rim tips back so the empty white interior becomes visible, then eases slightly toward a more upright side view. The pot and liquid remain essentially still. They show no pouring, filling, or level change. Small handheld jitter shifts the tiles and stove grates a few pixels, while the mug interior stays empty and the brown surface keeps its frothy edge.
